newsitem.title: USA: Provident to acquire Florida Gulfcoast.
newsitem.headline: Provident to acquire Florida Gulfcoast.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc., a Cincinnati-based financial services company, has a definitive agreement to acquire Florida Gulfcoast Bancorp Inc. for $34.9 million worth of its stock, the companies said Thursday.
The transaction is expected to close during the fourth quarter, subject to approval by Gulfcoast shareholders and banking regulators, they said.
Gulfcoast is the privately held parent of Enterprise National Bank, which operates three branches in Florida's Sarasota County.
Provident, with assets of $6.8 billion, operates Provident Consumer Financial Services; MeritValu, an online frequent shopper programme in Ohio and Florida; and three banking subsidiaries.
Provident's stock fell $1. to $38.75 on Nasdaq at midday.
